steps.text: Build the target number using place-value buttons — in as few taps as you can!
Each place-value button adds its own value. Tap the biggest button that still fits under the target — the app highlights the right one for you.
Keep adding smaller buttons (+10,000, +1,000 and so on) until you reach the target. Tap “Reset” to start over.
When your number matches the target exactly, the app highlights “Lock Build” — that's your cue to submit. (No need to lock an empty build.)
Fewer clicks means smarter place-value thinking — pick the biggest button that still fits.
